BiblicalUsage: Huri is a Gadite, named once as the father of Abihail in the genealogy of Gad. His name appears in a single line, and no deed is attached to it. He is a link in a chain, and the chain is the point.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Huri matters because a genealogy is a chain of real people, and every link holds the next one up.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
